world.name: The Shattered Kingdom of Eldoria
world.lore: Eldoria was once a beacon of magical prowess, but a cataclysm known as 'The Sundering' shattered the land and corrupted its magic. Now, monsters roam the ruins, and factions vie for control over the remaining sources of pure mana.

the_sundering_echo.title: The Sundering's Echo
the_sundering_echo.description: Discover the true cause of The Sundering and find a way to heal the land.

locations.name: Outpost of the Broken Shield
locations.description: A small, fortified village on the edge of the Whispering Woods, one of the last safe havens.

locations.name: Whispering Woods
locations.description: A forest twisted by wild magic. The trees seem to watch your every move.

locations.name: The Sunken Highway
locations.description: An ancient, grand road, now cracked and overgrown, partially submerged in a murky swamp.

item_templates.name: Rusty Sword
item_templates.description: A short sword, pitted with rust but still sharp enough to be dangerous.

item_templates.name: Small Healing Potion
item_templates.description: A vial of murky red liquid that smells of herbs. Restores health.

item_templates.name: Waterlogged Pouch
item_templates.description: A heavy leather pouch, soaked through. Something might be inside.

npc_templates.name: Elder Lyra
npc_templates.description: The wise, weary leader of the outpost. Her eyes have seen too much sorrow.
npc_templates.dialogue_prompt: You are Elder Lyra. You are cautious but hopeful. You carry the weight of your people's survival and seek a hero to help.

npc_templates.name: Boris the Blacksmith
npc_templates.description: A burly man with soot-stained hands and a perpetually grumpy expression.
npc_templates.dialogue_prompt: You are Boris, the blacksmith. You are gruff and pragmatic. You don't trust outsiders easily but respect strength and action.

npc_templates.name: Goblin Scout
npc_templates.description: A small, wiry creature with cruel, beady eyes, armed with a crude dagger.

npc_templates.name: Shadow Wolf
npc_templates.description: A large wolf with fur as dark as night and eyes that glow with faint, malevolent energy.

npc_templates.name: Giant Swamp Leech
npc_templates.description: A disgusting, bloated leech the size of a small dog. It moves with a sickening ripple.

quests.title: The Sundering's Echo
quests.description: Discover the true cause of The Sundering and find a way to heal the land.

steps.description: Find the Ancient Scroll in the Whispering Woods.
